projectScope: Batch 6 Phase 0 ownership domains at tracked source commit
includeRule: Tracked .cs files at gitCommit that equal or are beneath each declared scope path.
excludeRules: Generated runtime evidence and local game files
Documentation, scripts and package artifacts unless separately classified by Batch 5 rules

domains.nativeOwner: BodyController.UseFishRod; AgentStateFishingReady/Cast/Wait/Pull; FishingGameScrollBar; DolocUserInput; FishRodRenderer
domains.stateHolder: active Agent/state manager, selected FishRod, fishing phase caches, minigame handle, animator and Hook Rigidbody
domains.apiDelta: Remove first-party friend/primitives seam with the admitted pilot; keep frozen IFishingAutomationApi compatibility until its gate.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Product owns canonical Harmony owner, native caches, updater/session, input and cleanup; fifth-save behavior and GC authority.
domains.marginalPlan: Move fishing ProductNative and product QA out of mandatory GameBridge; isolate then retire Compatibility.

domains.nativeOwner: CameraController playable camera and Camera.orthographicSize; background/fog owners remain separately reviewed
domains.stateHolder: playable Camera plus DTMAPI lease/arbitration state
domains.apiDelta: Preserve compatibility until a focused consumer decision; no Camera stability promotion.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Product owns native zoom and restore; title/Manager global repair requires separate Platform/SharedNative proof.
domains.marginalPlan: Move single-product camera implementation to product; no mandatory replacement capability by default.

domains.nativeOwner: ToolCollider.HandleTools and AgentStateInteract.OnExit
domains.stateHolder: current tool/interact state and product completion policy
domains.apiDelta: Do not add a new product-shaped public API; review existing IActionCompletionApi compatibility during migration.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Product owns patch/state; any shared native exit hook needs two-consumer conflict proof.
domains.marginalPlan: Candidate only after AutoFishing proves the template.

domains.nativeOwner: PlantBasin.CouldHarvest and PlantBasin.Harvest(bool,bool)
domains.stateHolder: native crop container plus product target/scheduling policy
domains.apiDelta: Keep product-owned first; extract a transaction only after independent reuse.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Product owns scheduling and target state; explicit native transaction has no standing Hook today.
domains.marginalPlan: Move CropHarvesting implementation with product unless later SharedNative evidence exists.

domains.nativeOwner: AgentControllerState interaction timers and reviewed tool/plant/animal/electric/resin action owners
domains.stateHolder: current Agent state and product multiplier/restore markers
domains.apiDelta: Existing experimental contract needs a consumer-compatible migration decision; no promotion.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Product owns patches, markers and restoration; third-save behavior, independent GC ladder and clean exit remain required.
domains.marginalPlan: Migrate only after smaller template and AutoFishing proof.

domains.nativeOwner: DolocAPI.gameManager.archiveFileCount; LocalSave/DataPersistenceManager; GameDataUiState/GameDataPanel
domains.stateHolder: official archive count/files/UI plus product slot/page policy
domains.apiDelta: Preserve current experimental ABI until save/UI migration and compatibility review.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Product owns slot/page patches; Platform may own generic save data/lifecycle only.
domains.marginalPlan: Separate high-risk save/UI migration with rollback and user data evidence.

domains.nativeOwner: Product-specific debug verbs have separate native owners; command registration/logging is DTMAPI-owned Platform
domains.stateHolder: reflected console UI/modal state plus command registry
domains.targetAssembly: Optional DTMAPI.DebugConsoleMod plus Platform command service
domains.apiDelta: Keep generic command/log contract only; do not promote cheat/debug APIs.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Product owns UI, hotkey and native verbs; Platform owns owner-bound command cleanup.
domains.marginalPlan: Extract product UI/verbs; retain only generic command seam.

domains.nativeOwner: ArchiveDataHandle.GetAvailableInventories and native CountItem/CostItem paths
domains.stateHolder: available inventory set and product policy
domains.apiDelta: Review existing experimental API compatibility; no permanent internal service in GameBridge.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Product owns patch and merged policy state.
domains.marginalPlan: Move implementation with product after pilot gate.

domains.nativeOwner: ItemFishRoe.fishName and DolocAPI.QueryItemProto title lookup
domains.stateHolder: native item proto/title plus product tooltip policy
domains.apiDelta: Move product tooltip API use; only a future multi-consumer tooltip host may be shared.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Product owns tooltip patch/provider and cleanup.
domains.marginalPlan: No fish-roe-specific mandatory capability.

domains.nativeOwner: AnimalFullInfoData, AnimalViewer.Show and AnimalPanelUiState.Unregister
domains.stateHolder: native animal/viewer panel plus product progress rows
domains.apiDelta: Preserve experimental ABI until visual/native migration review; no promotion.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Product owns UI patches, coalescing and native-close cleanup.
domains.marginalPlan: Move viewer policy and patches with product; keep QA optional.

domains.nativeOwner: ItemFarmingGun construction/use and FarmingGunUiState transfer
domains.stateHolder: native farming-gun inventory/UI plus product three-slot policy
domains.apiDelta: Keep the experimental compatibility contract until the product migration decides its retained-consumer boundary.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Product owns patches, slot policy and exact capacity restore after migration.
domains.marginalPlan: Planned product remains blocked behind the earlier Batch 6 pilot and template gates.

domains.nativeOwner: GuaranteedManager -> ISpawnLut -> IDropItemHost official JSON path
domains.stateHolder: official drop tables and native spawn host
domains.targetAssembly: No product DLL; official JSON ContentPack
domains.apiDelta: No Oil public/native API; keep generic ActionCompletion separate.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Native official content path owns drop; no Oil Hook/session/cache.
domains.marginalPlan: Keep Oil separate from Mine and out of GameBridge.

domains.nativeOwner: native equipment/container, electric Launch, archive pass-time and production/storage owners
domains.stateHolder: placed equipment, native power/inventory state, exact-restorable recipe/tech/visual originals and a session-derived product scheduler
domains.targetAssembly: Official JSON ContentPack for static content plus the admitted DTMAPI.MineMod Advanced CodeMod for runtime cycle and economy; no new host assembly
domains.apiDelta: Do not keep IMachineProductionApi as a mandatory product engine and do not add a public machine DTO or host API.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Official JSON owns stable item/equipment/recipe/group content; ProductNative owns three exact-owner visual hooks, RNG, archive-time polling, fixed native power, transactional output, exact recipe/tech/visual restoration and a session-derived scheduler restarted after SaveLoaded. Title, disable and unload clear all session state.
domains.marginalPlan: Keep static content in official JSON and runtime/economy in the admitted Mine product; no Mine sidecar, candidate generation, journal, SharedNative or Content Host without a later explicit requirement and owner review.

domains.nativeOwner: AgentEquipmentFunction/Manager, AccessorySlot UI, native inventory/save transaction and shield hit path
domains.stateHolder: native equipment/inventory plus protected per-save sidecar and durable prepared/committed journal
domains.apiDelta: Freeze IEquipmentSlotsApi plus six DTOs as Experimental/Deprecated/Frozen: ProductNative is fixed at three slots while the existing Compatibility Host preserves legacy arbitrary-owner 0..24 semantics.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Product atomically owns four UI/native patches, fixed-three sidecar/journal recovery and disable/title/Loader cleanup; Compatibility owns only the frozen old ABI executor.
domains.marginalPlan: Separate migration with save backup, rollback and player evidence.

domains.nativeOwner: native animal creation/release, growth, feeding, breeding, production, capacity, AI, animation and save state
domains.stateHolder: native Animal/proto/room/save state plus host schema/resource generations
domains.apiDelta: G7 adds ContentPackFor/host contracts; species policy never enters host.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Host owns shared animal bridge, schema, asset generations and native cleanup; packs own species/economy.
domains.marginalPlan: Physically optionalize host after separate G7 design/validation.

domains.nativeOwner: No product-native owner; content is interpreted by the CustomAnimals host and official game tables
domains.stateHolder: species/economy/item/content files
domains.apiDelta: Depends on future G7 host contract without adding product code to host.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Content-only; host owns resource lifetime.
domains.marginalPlan: Consolidate species product content only after host contract.

domains.nativeOwner: WwiseSoundManager.InternalPostSoundEvent plus category-specific native context owners
domains.stateHolder: native Wwise event/context and host replacement/resource state
domains.targetAssembly: Optional audio Content Host after focused native-owner review
domains.apiDelta: Keep current experimental API frozen; split reusable host from paper-box/product QA.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Host candidate owns shared Wwise conflict/lifecycle only if two-consumer semantics remain equivalent.
domains.marginalPlan: Optionalize; do not hard-code each audio case in mandatory GameBridge.

domains.nativeOwner: Not established; loop, stop, callback, RTPC/state, bus and mixer owners remain unreviewed
domains.stateHolder: not established
domains.targetAssembly: Deferred optional host only after native-owner proof
domains.apiDelta: No API or stub.
domains.hookAndLifetime: No implementation admitted.
domains.marginalPlan: Research-only; zero base growth.

domains.nativeOwner: DTMAPI config registry, diagnostics snapshot and title settings UI host
domains.stateHolder: Core Manager model, ModConfigMenu registry and Bootstrap title UI
domains.apiDelta: Platform identity/status projection only; no gameplay API promotion.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Platform owns config/Manager lifecycle and player support rows, never product native behavior.
domains.marginalPlan: Retain Platform; future identity rows arrive atomically in G2.

domains.nativeOwner: DTMAPI event publication, content generation, demand accounting, runtime boundary and owner cleanup
domains.stateHolder: Core owner/event/demand/generation ledgers and boundary slots
domains.targetAssembly: DTMAPI.Core; only proven shared-native adapters remain in GameBridge
domains.apiDelta: Preserve generic Experimental event semantics; remove product-specific routes with products.
domains.hookAndLifetime: Platform owns thread/publication/owner cleanup; mixed GameBridge route files must split generic shell from product routes.
domains.marginalPlan: Retain generic Batch 5 kernel; zero product implementation growth.

domains.nativeOwner: Registry owner exists; animal/monster/projectile/attack/drone runtime creation owners are not established
domains.stateHolder: DTMAPI definition registry only; native runtime state intentionally absent
domains.targetAssembly: No admitted host; retire or internalize the speculative registry until a real optional ContentOwner is proven
domains.apiDelta: No silent removal; consumer scan and warning-bearing breaking boundary required.
domains.hookAndLifetime: No native creation Hook is admitted.
domains.marginalPlan: Freeze speculative expansion and plan retirement/internalization.

domains.nativeOwner: No Doloc Town multiplayer model established
domains.stateHolder: not established
domains.targetAssembly: No Batch 6 assembly; any future multiplayer Platform is an independent reviewed project
domains.apiDelta: No speculative API.
domains.hookAndLifetime: No implementation admitted.
domains.marginalPlan: Outside Batch 6.

domains.nativeOwner: Pet and independent vehicle owners require new focused reviews; retired MotorVehicle evidence is historical only
domains.stateHolder: not established
domains.targetAssembly: No admitted assembly; future pet and vehicle products remain ProductNative unless a focused review proves another owner
domains.apiDelta: Do not revive retired MotorVehicle API or preassign to CustomAnimals/GameBridge.
domains.hookAndLifetime: No implementation admitted.
domains.marginalPlan: Outside current migration admission.
